title: 第1151章 出逃第1150章 硬闯
slug: 双修暴击十万次仙子倒贴求放过
content_zh:
顾平抬手召回旧铁剑，左脚踩上段惊岳尚未收回的枪杆。
暗红大枪此刻长达万丈，一端握在段惊岳手中，另一端撑住倾塌缓坡。
顾平沿着枪杆向前疾奔三步，脚下每一步都踏出一圈黑白道纹，随后借段惊岳抬枪撑坡的力量跃上半空。
江观澜的一道冷白剑线从下方追来。
那道剑线拖着半条坠落星河，亿万星辉沿途汇聚，剑锋前方的虚空已经被切成上下两片。
顾平人在空中拧腰，旧铁剑从腋下向后递出。
剑锋先在遮天骨掌中央画出半道灰白圆弧，随后斜斜一带，将江观澜追来的星河剑线引进圆弧缺口。
冷白剑线补全最后半圈。
灰白剑弧与星河剑线在骨掌中央闭合，如同一轮残月终于圆满。
阴阳道纹沿着圆弧一正一反转动，两股本该彼此冲突的剑意被强行锁在同一轨迹中。
下一刻，遮天骨手从掌心向外寸寸裂开。
裂纹掠过之处，附着在骨骼上的魂道符文成片熄灭。
商无妄藏在掌中的黑色魂日也被剑气切成两半，失控魂火、灰白碎骨与残魂如同暴雨砸进后方人潮。
每一块碎骨落地，都会把青铜阵台砸出丈许深坑。
坑边爬满向外逃窜的魂影，几名躲避不及的散修刚被魂影扑中，识海便被撕开，抱着头从半空坠落。
散修们遭了无妄之灾。
商无妄抬旗护住头脸，苍白面孔终于沉了下来。
顾平又一次借了江观澜的剑。
这一剑斩掉的，正是他魂国里最强的镇魂骨手。
顾平落到叶青篱身旁，左臂揽住她的腰，将她从两尊坠落法相之间提起。

两人下方，一尊金甲神人和一头六臂凶猿同时砸进阵台。
金甲、猿臂与青铜砖碰撞，掀起的罡风将叶青篱的青衣吹得紧贴身躯，也让她腰侧已经凝住的鲜血重新渗出。
叶青篱腰侧伤口被勒得一疼，清丽面容瞬间失去血色。
她手中的长剑却先一步探出，青铜剑鳞贴着剑身急促震鸣。
方才混战之中，她始终在听辨铜墙后的兵鸣，替顾平寻找离开石殿的道路。
此刻顾平没有将她独自留下，她也未曾耽误半分。
叶青篱循着兵鸣一剑挑飞侧门铜闩：“右下三寸，门轴是空的！”
顾平一脚踹中她指出的位置。
阴阳道纹沿脚尖爆发，侧门下方的铜墙顿时向外鼓起。
隐藏在门轴内部的三十六重古阵接连崩灭，整扇侧门带着大片铜墙横飞出去。
轰！
门后压缩多年的山风猛灌进来。
狂风裹着湿土、树根和碎石冲过战场，吹得镇魂黑旗猎猎作响，也吹开了顾平斗笠下被血黏住的几缕黑发。
两人刚越过门槛，段惊岳已经从倾塌缓坡下拔出大枪。
他踏着军煞战虎越过人潮，背后残破军城沿途碾塌数尊法相。
暗红枪锋先贯穿侧门上方的山壁，再沿裂缝向下一压。
军城之中，数万铁骑同时挥动长戈。
军煞汇成一只压天巨掌，顺着枪锋按落。
整座铜山从中裂开，数百块山岳大小的铜石带着军煞火焰，从顾平头顶轰然坠落。
山河崩塌！

江观澜也在顷刻间追出侧门。
content_en:
Gu Ping raised his hand to recall the old iron sword, and stepped on Duan Jingyue's unretracted gun barrel with his left foot.
The dark red spear was now ten thousand feet long, with one end held in Duan Jingyue's hand and the other end supporting the gently sloping slope.
Gu Ping took three steps forward along the gun shaft, leaving a circle of black and white lines with every step he took. Then he used Duan Jingyue's strength to lift the gun to support the slope and jumped into the air.
Jiang Guanlan's cold white sword line chased him from below.
The sword line dragged half of the falling star river, and billions of stars gathered along the way. The void in front of the sword's edge had been cut into two pieces.
Gu Pingren twisted his waist in the air and held out the old iron sword from his armpit.
The sword edge first drew half a gray-white arc in the center of Zhetian Bone Palm, and then diagonally led the Xinghe sword line pursued by Jiang Guanlan into the arc gap.
The cold white sword line completed the last half circle.
The gray-white sword arc and the galaxy sword line closed in the center of the bone palm, like a waning moon finally completed.
The Yin-Yang Dao pattern rotates forward and backward along the arc, and the two sword intentions that should conflict with each other are forcibly locked in the same trajectory.
The next moment, the sky-covering bone hand split inch by inch from the palm outward.
Wherever the cracks passed, the soul runes attached to the bones were extinguished in pieces.
The black soul sun hidden in Shang Wuwang's palm was also cut in half by the sword energy, and the out-of-control soul fire, gray-white broken bones and residual souls hit the crowd behind like a heavy rain.
Every piece of bone that falls to the ground will smash the bronze formation into a deep pit of about ten feet.
The edge of the pit was crawling with soul shadows escaping outwards. As soon as a few casual cultivators who could not escape were hit by the soul shadows, their sea of ​​consciousness was torn open and they fell from the air holding their heads.
The casual cultivators suffered a terrible disaster.
Shang Wuwang raised his flag to protect his head and face, his pale face finally darkened.
Gu Ping borrowed Jiang Guanlan's sword again.
This sword cut off the strongest soul-suppressing bone hand in his soul kingdom.
Gu Ping fell next to Ye Qingli, put his left arm around her waist, and lifted her up from between the two fallen statues.
Below the two of them, a golden-armored god and a six-armed ferocious ape crashed into the formation at the same time.
The golden armor, ape arms and bronze bricks collided, and the strong wind caused Ye Qingli's green clothes to be blown close to her body, and the blood that had condensed on her waist seeped out again.
The wound on Ye Qingli's waist hurt from the strangulation, and his beautiful face lost all color in an instant.
The long sword in her hand reached out first, and the bronze sword scales vibrated rapidly against the sword body.
During the melee just now, she had been listening to the cries of soldiers behind the copper wall, looking for a way out of the stone palace for Gu Ping.
Gu Ping did not leave her alone at this moment, and she did not waste any time.
Ye Qingli followed the soldiers' cry and struck out the bronze bolt of the side door with his sword: "Three inches below the right, the door shaft is empty!"
Gu Ping kicked the spot she pointed out.
The Yin and Yang Dao lines exploded along the toes, and the copper wall under the side door suddenly bulged outward.
The thirty-six ancient formations hidden inside the door axis collapsed one after another, and the entire side door flew out with a large copper wall.
boom!
The mountain wind that had been compressed for many years rushed in behind the door.
The strong wind rushed across the battlefield wrapped in wet soil, tree roots and gravel, making the soul-soothing black flags rustle, and also blew away a few strands of Gu Ping's black hair that was stuck with blood under his bamboo hat.
As soon as the two of them crossed the threshold, Duan Jingyue had already pulled out a big gun from under the gentle slope.
He crossed the crowd on the back of a military tiger, crushing several Dharma statues along the way with the dilapidated military city behind him.
The dark red spear tip first penetrated the mountain wall above the side door, and then pressed down along the crack.
In the military city, tens of thousands of cavalry wielded their Changge at the same time.
The army demons merged into a huge palm that pressed down on the sky, and pressed down along the tip of the gun.
The entire copper mountain cracked open, and hundreds of mountain-sized copper stones fell from Gu Ping's head, carrying military evil flames.
Mountains and rivers collapse!
Jiang Guanlan also chased out of the side door in an instant.
